title: TitheTransaction
description: A record of a biblical giving transaction (tithe, offering, almsgiving, etc.) processed through the BibleFi protocol on Base chain. Fulfills Malachi 3:10: 'Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse.' Supports both manual and smart-contract-routed transactions.

transaction_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this transaction (UUID v4). NOTE: format:uuid is an assertion in validators that enforce formats (e.g. Ajv with ajv-formats); treat as annotation-only in validators that do not.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the TitheTransaction schema used. Must be 1.x.x for documents validated against this schema ($id v1).

sender_wallet.description: EVM wallet address of the giver on Base chain (chain_id: 8453).

sender_church_id.description: Links to church_record if this is a church-to-church tithe (UUID v4).

recipient_wallet.description: EVM wallet address of the recipient church, ministry, or protocol treasury on Base chain.

amount_wei.description: Amount in wei (uint256 as string to avoid JavaScript precision loss). Convert: amount_wei / 10^decimals = token amount.

amount_usd.description: USD equivalent at time of transaction (informational only; not used for on-chain settlement).

asset.description: Token asset used for this giving transaction.

contract_address.description: ERC-20 token contract address. Use zero address (0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000) for native ETH.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID for this asset. BibleFi primary chain = Base mainnet (8453).

coingecko_id.description: CoinGecko asset ID for price lookups (informational).

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID for this transaction. BibleFi primary chain = Base mainnet (8453).

tx_hash.description: On-chain transaction hash (32-byte hex). Only present after the transaction is confirmed on-chain.

block_number.description: Block number at which the transaction was confirmed.

transaction_type.description: Biblical category of giving. tithe = 10% of income per Malachi 3:10. firstfruits = first portion per Proverbs 3:9-10. offering = freewill gift per 2 Corinthians 9:7.

scripture_reference.description: Scripture backing this giving transaction. Recommended: Malachi 3:10 for tithes, Proverbs 3:9 for firstfruits, 2 Corinthians 9:7 for offerings.

notes.description: Optional notes about this scripture reference.

percentage_of_income.description: If provided, the percentage of income this transaction represents (e.g. 10.0 = traditional tithe per Malachi 3:10).

is_recurring.description: Whether this is part of a recurring giving schedule.

recurrence_interval.description: Interval for recurring giving. Only meaningful when is_recurring is true.

giving_strategy_id.description: Links to a defi_strategy record if this tithe comes from yield generated by a BibleFi DeFi strategy (UUID v4).

smart_contract_routed.description: Whether this transaction was routed via a BibleFi smart contract on Base chain.

contract_address.description: BibleFi tithe router or splitter contract address on Base chain (if smart_contract_routed is true).

attestation.description: On-chain attestation record for this giving transaction. Use attestation_type: eas_attestation for EAS on Base chain.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID for the attestation.

block_number.description: Block number at which attestation was confirmed.

ipfs_cid.description: IPFS CID for off-chain attestation data (CIDv0 or CIDv1).

attested_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the attestation was created.

attested_by.description: Identifier of the attesting agent or contract.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes about this giving transaction.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for filtering and indexing.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was last updated.
